title: Autumn's Story: Surviving a Plane Crash
shared_passage:
Watch a video about a teenager who survived a plane crash. For questions 1 to 7, decide if the statements are true or false.

AUTUMN VEATCH: I was positive I was gonna die, and then I was positive I was gonna live.

With just 30 minutes left in their flight, the plane hit stormy weather and crashed into a mountain in the North Cascades.

She couldn't get to her grandmother through the flames and burned her hand trying to free her grandfather.

Veatch said she thought she had fallen asleep and was having a nightmare, but there would be no sleep for two more days.

Having watched shows like Survivorman, she knew if she found a stream, she could follow it to a trail, then a highway.

AUTUMN VEATCH: I was trying to hitchhike, trying to get a ride, flag somebody down, but nobody would stop.

AUTUMN VEATCH: I definitely have never wanted to live more in my life. Having a second chance is the best thing that could have ever happened.

questions.question: She never thought she was going to survive.
The plane crashed due to a storm.
After the crash, she tried to rescue her grandfather.
When the plane crashed, she was sleeping.
She could find her way out of the forest thanks to a TV show.
Once she reached the highway, a car took her immediately.
After what happened, it's hard for her to find the strength to live again.
